start.title: Writing in the Rime
start.text: On the shaded wall of an abandoned shed, frost has formed in lines too regular to be natural. The patterns resemble letters only when you stop trying to read them directly.

choices.text: Study the pattern without touching it

buckets.flavourText: The marks repeat in groups of six around a central gap, like instructions for arranging something rather than words.
The repetition is deliberate, but its purpose slips whenever you focus on a single symbol.
Your eyes water from staring. The marks seem to rearrange whenever you blink.

pattern.title: Six Around One
pattern.text: You trace the structure with your gaze: six marks, a pause, six more. The empty centre of each group aligns with nail holes in the timber. Something used to hang here.

choices.text: Hang the drowned bell in the empty centre
Press a warm coin to one of the empty centres
Memorise the pattern and leave it intact

touch_choice.title: Cold That Notices You
touch_choice.text: Standing this close, you feel a faint pressure behind the eyes—the same sensation as spending mana, except nothing has been cast.

choices.text: Touch the rime with one fingertip

coin.title: A Ring of Clear Wood
coin.text: The frost recoils from the coin in six thin spokes. For an instant, the wood beneath shows a burned symbol: a door drawn as a square inside a circle. Then the rime closes over it again.

memory.title: A Pattern Kept
memory.text: You repeat the sequence until you can picture it with your eyes closed. The frost remains undisturbed for whoever—or whatever—made it.

touch.title: Borrowed Cold
touch.text: The frost melts beneath your fingertip, then races back over the wet patch in branching lines. A sharp pulse runs up your arm and is gone before you can decide whether it was pain.

erase.title: Ordinary Wood Beneath
erase.text: The frost flakes away easily. Beneath it is weathered timber and several old nail holes. Within seconds, new crystals begin forming at the edges of the cleared patch.

leave.title: Unanswered Pattern
leave.text: You leave the wall as you found it. The pattern is still visible when you glance back from the road.

bell_answer.title: The Bell Answers
bell_answer.text: The bell hangs where the missing object once did. Frost threads across the bronze in six branching lines. It rings without moving—one clear note that leaves a square-within-a-circle etched into the metal before the rime goes still.
bell_answer.miscText: Whatever the wall expected, the bell was close enough to be recognised.

choices.text: Take the altered bell and return
